name: cja-health

name: cja-reports
after: Dataview Reports lets you choose an existing data view, load its dimensions and metrics, and build a report with a date range, up to 20 metrics, optional segments, and row limits. Date dimensions produce trended reports, and other dimensions produce ranked ones. Each metric gets summary insights such as its total, top item and share, and period-over-period change. You can download the latest report as CSV, JSON, or Word, along with the exact request sent to CJA.
caption: Data view reports with metrics and export options

name: cja-compare
after: Compare Data Views matches dimensions and metrics by exact component ID and shows what exists only in one view, what is shared, and which fields differ. Missing fields are distinguished from explicit nulls, so a difference is never a guess.
caption: Comparing dimensions and metrics across data views

name: cja-metrics
after: Metrics retrieves the full metric catalog for a data view, including every page of results, and lets you search and download it.
caption: Searchable metrics catalog

after: Most of the app is read-only. The exception is Annotations, where you can create annotations and partially update existing ones.
